entry.name: xbendout
entry.digest: Format extra precision MIDI pitch bend messages
entry.description: Formats messages which occupy both bytes of the MIDI pitch bend message. xbendout2 allows you to send the pitch bend data as two bytes from 0-127.

arguments.name: xbendout2
arguments.description: If the object is called, there will be three inlets. The most significant byte of the pitch bend message is received in the left inlet, and the least significant (extra precision) byte is received in the middle inlet.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.description: The number sets an initial value for the MIDI channel of the pitch bend messages. If there is no argument, the initial channel number is.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Sends out a MIDI pitch bend message using the numbers currently stored in.

messages.name: in1
messages.description: In right inlet: The number is stored as the MIDI channel for the pitch bend message sent out by. Channel numbers greater than 16 will be wrapped around to stay within the 1-16 range.

messages.name: in2
messages.description: The number is stored as the MIDI channel for the pitch bend message sent out by. Channel numbers greater than 16 will be wrapped around to stay within the 1-16 range.

messages.name: int
messages.description: The number is a 14-bit pitch bend value to be formatted into a complete MIDI pitch bend message by.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Input both values, send pitch bend data
messages.description: The first number is a 14-bit pitch bend value, and the second number is the channel. Both numbers are stored and are formatted into a MIDI pitch bend message which is sent out the outlet.
